summary_en: BCJ-110, a subsidiary of Bain Capital-backed BCJ-109, launched a tender offer for eSOL common shares at 820 yen per share from September 2 to October 19, 2026, targeting 17,109,020 shares with a minimum of 10,535,800 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Commencement of a Tender Offer for Common Shares of eSOL Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 4420) by BCJ-110 Inc.
translation_en_brief:
BCJ-110 Inc., established on June 1, 2026, announced the commencement of a tender offer for all common shares of eSOL Co., Ltd. (Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market, ticker 4420) on September 1, 2026. The offer price is 820 yen per share, with a tender period of 30 business days from September 2 to October 19, 2026. The bidder targets acquisition of 17,109,020 shares, with a minimum threshold of 10,535,800 shares; no upper limit has been specified. Settlement is scheduled for October 26, 2026.

BCJ-110 is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BCJ-109, whose voting rights are indirectly held entirely by Bain Capital Private Equity, LP and its affiliated investment funds (collectively, "Bain Capital"). The tender offer represents an acquisition by a financial investor with the principal objective of acquiring and controlling eSOL's shares and business operations. Nomura Securities Inc. serves as the tender offer agent.
